before.title_zh: 形成能力、实际运用与接续
before.title_en: Formed capacity, actual exercise and continuation
before.claim_zh: 能力已形成、能力实际被运用、下轮条件得到再形成是不同关系；任意高的有限完成可能，不能仅凭这些替代可能性推出一条实际持续形成的历史。 固定规律下的旧可达性区分现细化为共同实现的准备步骤界：实际准备可改变当前一步能力，解除共同条件可失去最终共同实现，已有能力也可能未被使用。 进一步区别形态保留与有支持的作用：维持活动可要求改变支承路径，恢复一项条件可伴随另一项耗竭；形成、维持、转化、退化与结束须按实际关系同时说明。 明示共同操作还可在双方完整局部状态不变时改变后续响应；保留相应交叉项可准确跟随指定操作的任意有限序列。
before.claim_en: Formed capacity, its actual exercise and renewed next-stage conditions are distinct; arbitrarily high finite completion possibilities do not by themselves establish one history of ongoing actual formation. The existing fixed-law reachability distinction now has an explicit preparation bound for joint realization: actual preparation can change current one-step capacity, release can remove eventual joint realization, and available capacity can remain unused. The continuation distinguishes retained form from supported efficacy: maintaining an activity can require changing its provision route, and restoring one condition can exhaust another. Formation, maintenance, transformation, degeneration and ending are explained through their actual relationships. A specified joint operation can also change later responses while both complete local states stay fixed; retaining the relevant cross contribution gives exact responses along every finite word of the declared operations.
before.scope_zh: 局部 Lean 与独立重建已查；善的身份待证；有界细化模块12项定理／18项审计已查，含旧推论重述，不是12项独立成果；旧有限耦合模型未解释耦合来源，完整目标未证；此前解释整合无新定理；本次关系约化模块11项定理／25项审计通过，量子前提明示，不证明Becoming整体必然性
before.scope_en: Local Lean and independent reconstruction checked; ethical identity open; bounded-refinement module checks 12 theorem declarations/18 audits, including restated prior inferences rather than 12 independent results; the old finite coupling law does not explain coupling origin; the full target remains open; the prior explanatory synthesis adds no theorem; the new relational-reduction module checks 11 theorem declarations/25 audits with explicit quantum premises, without proving whole-Becoming necessity
